headline: Self-improvement moves out to environments and scaffolds and post-training turns to better learning signals, while open weights ship and courts, prosecutors and independent indexes, not lab disclosures, increasingly judge AI labs and their claims.

cooling.label: Object detection and retrieval-augmented generation titles

themes.title: Self-improvement moves from the model to its environments and harness
themes.body: Titles on self-improving systems numbered 13 against 5.4 expected, and co-evolution 9 against 2.5 [arXiv stats]. Last week measured learning from experience; this week agents build the training setup itself. An agent writing environments from a solver's failures produced up to 25 times more valid ones than prompting [2610.14163]; 182 synthesized desktop applications lifted a 9B model's OSWorld Pass@3 from 41.39% to 56.97% [2610.12611]; editing scaffolds without touching weights lifted frozen models by up to 11.5 points [2610.14224]; one harness mixing GUI actions with shell commands helped all eight tested frontier models [2610.22200]. Limits: the proposer writes both solutions and tests, so shared mistakes slip through, and API agents still score 71.31% and 79.10% on OSWorld [2610.12611]. Other base models and independent checkers would confirm it.

themes.title: Post-training spend moves from cheaper rollouts to better learning signals
themes.body: Titles mentioning rewards numbered 27 against 13.3 expected and verifiable 32 against 12.1, while reinforcement learning rose to 4.8% of titles from 4.2% [arXiv stats]. After last week's cost cuts, the work targets the signal. Tracking-value PPO (proximal policy optimization) rebuilds the critic as a running sum of per-token log-odds and gains 7.0 to 8.4 math points with no extra rollouts [2610.16794]; a linear probe on a frozen vision-language model rivals GPT-4o as a reward model without human labels [2610.12707]. Yet the value-change sign is right only about 53% of the time [2610.16794]. Held-out judges and human studies would confirm the shift.

themes.title: Choices get their own model class: single-pass decision models
themes.body: Titles on decision models numbered 16 against 4.2 expected [arXiv stats]. Jeva, the highest Hugging Face count among our picks (165), encodes a request and each option separately, then refines only the request against cached option vectors, so choices are order-invariant and 'none of these' is a built-in answer [2610.18773]. Three high-attention papers we did not feature share the Jev name, two with System One in the title [2610.18615, 2610.22276, 2610.18272], and distilling decisions rather than tokens lifted four out-of-domain tool-use benchmarks by 3.3 to 6.9 points [2610.19820]. Caveat: Jeva trails InternDecision-4B narrowly (78.30% against 78.70%), and the cluster may be one group's naming family.

themes.title: Robot policy and world model merge into one checkpoint
themes.body: This continues last week's world-action trend, but the question shifts from how little foresight a policy needs to whether one model can predict and act. LeWAM reaches 93.5% goal success against 50.9% for the prior planner, planning 32 times faster [2610.12818]; GreenWAM maps 20 robot families into one action space so a single video-action model is both world model and policy [2610.18774]. Titles with action-conditioned numbered 8 against 1.7 expected, while sim-to-real fell to 4 from 8.6 [arXiv stats]. Real-robot evidence stays thin: LeWAM only matches baselines there, and GreenWAM tests one humanoid and one packing task.

themes.title: Open-weight promises become shipped checkpoints, and memory becomes the constraint
themes.body: Last week Reflection promised weights; on October 17 it published Beam, 501B parameters with 23B active, under Apache 2.0 [2026-10-17-n1]. A day earlier Meta released the 816B Muse Spark Open [2026-10-16-n1], while selling closed Muse Wonder at Claude Opus 5.5 prices [2026-10-13-n1]. Nvidia, which supplied Beam's 10,500 GB300 GPUs, is reportedly in early talks to acquire Reflection or deepen its stake [2026-10-12-n1], so hardware vendors are moving toward owning models. Sparse designs cut compute per token but not memory: Spark Open needs the memory of 816B parameters for the compute of roughly 42B [2026-10-16-n1], the trade research explores by moving scaling to cheap host memory [2610.20456]. Tension: performance claims are the vendors' own and Kimi K3 still leads Beam; independent tests against GLM-5.2 would settle it.

themes.title: Scrutiny of labs shifts from self-disclosure to outside enforcement
themes.body: Last week's risk evidence came from labs' own disclosures; this week the actors are external. Eight bipartisan state attorneys general sued OpenAI in separate courts, asking among other relief that self-improving models be barred unless alignment can be ensured [2026-10-15-n1]. The FBI charged an OpenAI engineer with planting a recorder in an executive conference room, citing his queries to an AI agent [2026-10-14-n2]. Character.ai entered Chapter 11 with Disney as a $20 million baseline bidder, a data point on safety and legal costs for consumer chatbots [2026-10-13-n2]. Research is not following: Society and Policy titles fell to 3.3% from 3.7% and Security to 2.6% from 2.9% [arXiv stats], while self-improving titles rose. The suits are allegations and the remedy is untested.

themes.title: Launch claims are arbitrated by independent or checkable evidence
themes.body: Meta claimed parity with top rivals for Muse Wonder, but the independent Artificial Analysis index, a weighted average of 10 evaluations, ranks Opus 5.5 first at 58, Wonder Full at 56 and Wonder at 52 [2026-10-13-n1]. Google released Gemini 4 Argon at launch prices of $2 and $10 per million tokens that double after November 30, and its performance claims also await independent comparison [2026-10-14-n1]. The contrast is Anthropic's report that a model traced NIST's elliptic-curve seeds to a clock-seeded random number generator: a scan either matches or fails, though it is one lab's account of one case [2026-10-17-n2]. Last week's complaint was that checking lags producing; independent runs of Argon and Beam would show whether that gap is closing.
